format: html

## 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Core libraries
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(progressr)
library(lhs) # For LHS data generation

# Load all our custom functions
source("../../R/data_generator.R")
source("../../R/solvers.R")

# --- LHS Generators (defined here for portability) ---
generate_X_t_LHS <- function(n, p, df_X, scale_X = 1, ...) {
  hypercube <- randomLHS(n, p)
  X_raw <- qt(hypercube, df = df_X)
  return(X_raw * scale_X)
}

generate_E_t_LHS <- function(n, m, df_E, scale_E = 1, ...) {
  hypercube <- randomLHS(n, m)
  E_raw <- qt(hypercube, df = df_E)
  return(E_raw * scale_E)
}
```

## 2. Final Simulation Parameters

Parameters are based on the results from the scenario discovery phase.

```{r final-params}
# --- Best Battlefield Data Generation Parameters ---
BEST_SCALE_X <- 1.0
BEST_DF_X <- 3.5
DF_E <- 1.5

# --- Fixed Model Parameters ---
P <- 200
M <- 4
S_STAR <- 2

# Define the fixed, integer-valued true Theta_star
THETA_STAR <- matrix(0, nrow = P, ncol = M)
THETA_STAR[1:S_STAR, ] <- matrix(c(5, 4, 5, 5, 6, 4, 4, 5), nrow = S_STAR, byrow = TRUE)

# --- Final Simulation Grid ---
N_SEQUENCE_FINAL <- seq(200, 1400, by = 300)
METHODS <- c("RIGHT", "IHT", "Shrinkage", "Adaptive Huber", "Lasso")
N_REPS_FINAL <- 300 # A reasonable number for a local final run

param_grid_final <- expand.grid(
  n = N_SEQUENCE_FINAL,
  method = METHODS,
  rep_id = 1:N_REPS_FINAL
)
```

## 3. Main Simulation Loop (Parallel)

This is the main execution block, implementing the fair comparison framework.

```{r main-loop-final, cache=TRUE}
# --- Setup Parallel Backend ---
num_cores <- max(1, detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cores = num_cores)
cat(sprintf("Running final simulation on %d cores.\n", num_cores))

# --- Run the loop with a progress bar ---
execution_time <- system.time({
  with_progress({
    p_bar <- progressor(steps = nrow(param_grid_final))
    
    results_list <- foreach(
      i = 1:nrow(param_grid_final),
      .combine = 'rbind',
      .packages = c("dplyr", "glmnet", "lhs")
    ) %dopar% {
      
      p_bar()
      
      # --- Setup for each task ---
      source("../../R/data_generator.R")
      source("../../R/solvers.R")
      # Make LHS generators available to workers
      generate_X_t_LHS <- function(n, p, df_X, scale_X = 1, ...) {
        hypercube <- lhs::randomLHS(n, p)
        X_raw <- qt(hypercube, df = df_X)
        return(X_raw * scale_X)
      }
      generate_E_t_LHS <- function(n, m, df_E, scale_E = 1, ...) {
        hypercube <- lhs::randomLHS(n, m)
        E_raw <- qt(hypercube, df = df_E)
        return(E_raw * scale_E)
      }
      
      params <- param_grid_final[i, ]
      n <- params$n
      method <- as.character(params$method)
      rep_id <- params$rep_id
      
      set.seed(i)
      
      # Generate full dataset using the BEST SCENARIO and LHS
      sim_data <- generate_multi_response_data(
        n = n, p = P, m = M, Theta_star = THETA_STAR,
        generator_X = generate_X_t_LHS,
        generator_E = generate_E_t_LHS,
        df_X = BEST_DF_X, scale_X = BEST_SCALE_X,
        df_E = DF_E
      )
      X_full <- sim_data$X
      Y_full <- sim_data$Y
      
      # --- UNIFIED 80/20 Split for ALL tuning procedures ---
      train_size <- floor(0.8 * n)
      train_idx <- sample(1:n, size = train_size)
      X_train <- X_full[train_idx, ]; Y_train <- Y_full[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
      X_val <- X_full[-train_idx, ]; Y_val <- Y_full[-train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
      
      # --- Run Solver based on Method ---
      Theta_hat <- switch(
        method,
        "RIGHT" = {
          s <- 2 * S_STAR; eta <- 0.01; T_max <- 400; c_K <- 1.0
          K <- max(1, round(c_K * (M + log(P) + log(log(n) / (M + log(P))))))
          solver_right(X_full, Y_full, s, eta, T_max, K, grad_func_samplewise = grad_multi_response_samplewise)
        },
        "IHT" = {
          s <- 2 * S_STAR; eta <- 0.001; T_max <- 600
          solver_iht(X_full, Y_full, s, eta, T_max, grad_func = grad_multi_response)
        },
        "Lasso" = {
          cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_train, Y_train, family = "mgaussian", standardize = FALSE, intercept = FALSE)
          lambda_best <- cv_fit$lambda.min
          final_fit <- glmnet(X_full, Y_full, family = "mgaussian", lambda = lambda_best, standardize = FALSE, intercept = FALSE)
          coef_list <- coef(final_fit, s = lambda_best)
          do.call(cbind, lapply(coef_list, function(m) as.vector(m)[-1]))
        },
        "Shrinkage" = {
          tau_x_fixed <- quantile(abs(X_train), 0.95)
          tau_y_fixed <- quantile(abs(Y_train), 0.95)
          X_train_shrunk <- truncate_operator(X_train, tau_x_fixed)
          Y_train_shrunk <- truncate_operator(Y_train, tau_y_fixed)
          cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_train_shrunk, Y_train_shrunk, family = "mgaussian", standardize = FALSE, intercept = FALSE)
          lambda_best <- cv_fit$lambda.min
          solver_shrinkage_method_multi(X_full, Y_full, tau_x_fixed, tau_y_fixed, lambda_best)
        },
        "Adaptive Huber" = {
          cv_lasso_init <- cv.glmnet(X_train, Y_train, family = "mgaussian", standardize = FALSE, intercept = FALSE)
          coef_list_init <- coef(cv_lasso_init, s = "lambda.min")
          Theta_init_lasso <- do.call(cbind, lapply(coef_list_init, function(m) as.vector(m)[-1]))
          residuals_init <- Y_train - X_train %*% Theta_init_lasso
          tau_fixed <- quantile(abs(residuals_init), 0.95)
          
          lambda_grid <- 10^seq(-2, 1, length.out = 10)
          best_mse <- Inf
          lambda_best <- NA
          for (lambda_val in lambda_grid) {
            Theta_tuned <- solver_huber_group_lasso(X_train, Y_train, lambda_val, tau_fixed, T_max = 250)
            Y_pred_val <- X_val %*% Theta_tuned
            mse_val <- mean((Y_val - Y_pred_val)^2)
            if (is.finite(mse_val) && mse_val < best_mse) {
              best_mse <- mse_val
              lambda_best <- lambda_val
            }
          }
          if(is.na(lambda_best)) { return(data.frame(n=n, method=method, rep_id=rep_id, l2_error=NA)) }
          solver_huber_group_lasso(X_full, Y_full, lambda_best, tau_fixed, T_max = 500)
        }
      )
      
      # --- Calculate and return results ---
      l2_error <- if(any(is.na(Theta_hat))) NA else sqrt(sum((Theta_hat - THETA_STAR)^2))
      data.frame(n = n, method = method, rep_id = rep_id, l2_error = l2_error)
    }
  })
})

# --- Stop the parallel cluster ---
stopImplicitCluster()
#cat("重复次数", N_REPS_FINAL, " 花费时间")
#print(execution_time)
```

## 4. Analysis and Visualization

```{r analysis-final}
local_results_df <- results_list
#saveRDS(local_results_df, "../../results/03_Third_simulation_comparison_multiresponse/raw_results_multi_comparison.rds")

summary_local <- local_results_df %>%
  group_by(n, method) %>%
  summarise(mean_l2_error = mean(l2_error, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

#print(summary_local)
 saveRDS(summary_local, "../../results/03_Third_simulation_comparison_multiresponse/final_results_multi_comparison.rds")

summary_local <- summary_local %>%
  filter(is.finite(mean_l2_error) & mean_l2_error > 0) %>%
  mutate(log_n = log(n), log_error = log(mean_l2_error))

summary_local$method <- factor(summary_local$method, 
                               levels = c("RIGHT", "Adaptive Huber", "Shrinkage", "Lasso", "IHT"))

multi_comparison_final <- ggplot(summary_local, aes(x = log_n, y = log_error, color = method, group = method, shape = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
   # title = "Final Comparison: Multi-Response Regression",
    #subtitle = "Log Mean L2 Error vs. Log Sample Size under Heavy-Tailed Conditions",
    x = "Log(Sample Size, n)",
    y = "Log(Mean L2 Error)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
         legend.title = element_text(size = 16), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)   )+
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Method") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Method",
    values = c("RIGHT" = 16, "Adaptive Huber" = 17, "Shrinkage" = 15, "Lasso" = 18, "IHT" = 4)
  )

print(multi_comparison_final)
#ggsave("final_comparison_multi_model.png", multi_comparison_final, height = 4, width = 10, dpi = 300)
```

library(ggplot2)
selected_palette <- c(

  "Adaptive Huber" = "#3B82A1",  # Cyan

  "Lasso"          = "#CAB54B" ,# Sand
  "IHT"            = "#CC6677"  # Rose
)

                               levels = c("RIGHT", "Adaptive Huber", "Shrinkage", "Lasso", "IHT"))



multi_comparison_final <- ggplot(

  aes(x = log_n, y = log_error, color = method, group = method, shape = method)
) +
 
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(size = 2.9) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Log(Sample Size, n)",
    y = "Log(Mean L2 Error)"
  ) +
  
 
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Method",
    values = selected_palette,
    drop = FALSE 
  ) +
  
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Method",
    values = c("RIGHT" = 16, "Adaptive Huber" = 17, "Shrinkage" = 15, "Lasso" = 12, "IHT" = 4),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) + 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )


print(multi_comparison_final)
